Class PainterCommands

java.lang.Object
co.aikar.commands.BaseCommand
dev.despical.pixelpainter.command.PainterCommands
public final class PainterCommands extends co.aikar.commands.BaseCommand
Receives ACF invocations and dispatches validated painting requests.

Each action passes through shared permission checks and configured error panels. Actions are registered once as handlers, so a new command needs a catalog entry and a handler without touching dispatch. The dispatcher parses arguments, captures request settings and delegates to file/image workers or the server-thread painting service.

Per-player tokens suppress stale preparation results after cancellation or disconnect. File operations retain reservations until completion because cancellation cannot roll back a source mutation. Worker callbacks return through the plugin scheduler before accessing player or world state.
